children: is planning to raise prices on some chips, dips, and soft drinks, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter, as the company seeks to improve sales while managing higher costs.

The planned increases would affect grocery-store-sized bags of brands including Doritos, Ruffles, and SunChips, with the changes expected late this year or in early 2027, according to the report. Prices on some chips are expected to rise by a low- to mid-single-digit percentage.

The company cut prices on several major chip brands by as much as 15% in February in an effort to revive demand after some products sold for more than $7 a bag. The company’s North American food business subsequently posted a 2% revenue decline and flat volumes in its most recent quarterly results.
has increased prices on some larger Tostitos salsa jars and Fritos canned dips. The company is also expected to raise prices on some soft drinks, the report said.
spokesperson told Bloomberg that prices after the planned increases would remain below levels before the earlier cuts and said the company remained focused on affordability.
The company is facing higher operating costs and pressure from a strained US consumer environment.

title: PepsiCo to lift prices on some snacks after earlier cuts fail to boost sales
